thread:
jason_dx: Triage: onboarding quickstart shows 'GenericError' when token expires. JS SDK not mapping 401->AuthError.

maya_sdk: Hmm, we intentionally kept a flat HTTPError in v1, but agree we should add a few typed classes for common actionable cases.

chris_samples: In the sample-app flow we get a red banner 'Request failed' with no hint. New devs keep filing support tickets saying the service is down.

jason_dx: Proposal: map 401->AuthError (retry_hint: refresh_token), 403->PermissionError (include role hint), 429->RateLimitError (attach retry_after), >=500->InternalError. Add a user_message string for UI.

maya_sdk: I'll add an errors.ts compatibility layer: HTTPError remains base but we'll instantiate AuthError/PermissionError/RateLimitError that subclass it. Preserve .status and .body for backward compatibility.

chris_samples: Sample-app plan: catch errors, show user_message if present, call auth.startSignIn() on AuthError, show countdown when RateLimitError with Retry-After header.

ops-bot: [ci] Pipeline queued for branch feature/typed-error-mapping (#7610).

jason_dx: Tests: unit mapping tests for 401/429/403 + small e2e that simulates 429 and verifies UI countdown. Also add copy snippets to docs.

maya_sdk: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-js/pull/7610 - contains mapping, unit tests, changelog note.

ops-bot: [ci] Build passed for #7610, merging.

chris_samples: Docs updated and sample-app live. Assigning a one-week watch to support to see if 'service down' tickets drop.

jason_dx: Thanks team. This should improve onboarding clarity and reduce churn.
